title: D4-A2-V1 Paired Retrieval Stability and Variance Attribution Validation Preregistration

implementation_freeze_contract.description: Implementation freeze identity is defined non-self-referentially as the Git commit containing this preregistration (Commit A). The runtime execution runner captures git rev-parse HEAD dynamically before Phase P draw #1, verifies a clean worktree, and records that exact Commit A SHA in raw artifacts and closeout.

scientific_scope.query: The restgas analysis determines the event vertex through a two-step POCA workflow. What does the first worker step leave behind for the second analysis step, and how is the fitted vertex fed into the reprocessing?
scientific_scope.excluded_cases: No other novel_dev cases, no Gold cases, no novel_validation, no holdout.

phase_p_specification.freeze_policy: All 8 plans frozen to evaluation/d4_a2_v1_raw_analyzer_plan_samples.json and committed (Commit B) before Phase R.

shared_plan_adapter_guarantees.plan_identity: BEFORE_PLAN == AFTER_PLAN == frozen plan_i (verified by canonical model_dump equality)
shared_plan_adapter_guarantees.adapter_lifecycle: Restores Retriever.analyze on cell completion or exception; fail-closed on error.

arm_definitions.BEFORE_COMPAT: Production query expansions with Batch-1 fixed locators active, generic D3.5 structured replacement OFF, reserved admission OFF.
arm_definitions.AFTER_BATCH1_REPLACEMENT: Exact in-memory Batch-1 component mask active, generic D3.5 structured replacement ON, d3_5_selectivity_v2 ON (caps 8/4), K=3 reserved admission, rerank pool size = 30.

verdict_precedence.condition: Wrong plan count, wrong pair count, analyzer called inside Phase R, BEFORE/AFTER plan mismatch, wrong mask, wrong K/selectivity, post-exposure mutation, protected dataset violation, or incomplete execution.
PAIR_TREATMENT_REGRESSION_COUNT >= 2 at pre-rerank final-pool availability under shared analyzer plans.
PAIR_TREATMENT_REGRESSION_COUNT == 1 or mixed treatment regressions/recoveries make direction unstable.
PAIR_TREATMENT_REGRESSION_COUNT == 0, but final-evidence paired results exhibit reproducible AFTER disadvantage while pre-rerank availability remains equivalent.
distinct_plan_signature_count == 1 and no meaningful plan-to-evidence variation occurs.
Multiple analyzer plans occur (distinct_plan_signature_count >= 2) but n022.e2 pre-rerank availability is stable across all frozen plans.

8/8 analyzer draws valid, 16/16 shared-plan downstream cells valid, ANALYZER_PLAN_VARIABILITY_OBSERVED = true, PLAN_TO_EVIDENCE_SENSITIVITY_OBSERVED = true, PAIR_TREATMENT_REGRESSION_COUNT = 0, no reproducible final-only AFTER disadvantage, direct Batch-1 mask effect on n022 = false, structured treatment not required to explain plan-driven losses.
